blocks.text: This is the first status note on our licensing diligence for {{fact:f:E-2025-001.client}}, and we will keep later updates and document requests on this thread so they stay in one place. Richard and I have the file histories for every patent and published application on the license schedule, and we are reading them now, he on the device claims and I on the electrical and control claims.

The assignment records are also in hand, and we are checking each chain from the named inventors through to the licensor. The drawings your engineering team sent were enough to start charting the device claims, but several of the control claims turn on the order in which the controller firmware carries out its steps, and the drawings do not show that.
When you can, please send us the following:
1. The firmware documentation for the controller, which is still open from our first request, or a written description of its operating sequence if no formal documentation exists.
2. Any revised patent schedule the licensor sends. Our review follows that schedule, and a change to it changes the work.
Nothing in this note is a view on coverage or validity. Mary will give you that in writing when the review is complete.
